_note: A loss within the capital-gains head set off against its other parts (D-243; rulebook SETOFF-INTRA-CG-001, R18). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.108(2) (p.147): "(a) any short-term capital asset is a loss, such loss shall be set off against the income, computed in respect of any other capital asset for that year; (b) any long-term capital asset is a loss, such loss shall be set off against the income computed in respect of any other long-term capital asset for that year". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.70(2), (3) as substituted by the Finance Act, 2002 s.27 (Goa reprint p.1375; thc copy p.318), the same asymmetry. Neither Act orders the parts a loss absorbs: CapitalGainsAbsorptionOrder is a declared default — short-term slab, short-term listed equity, long-term other, long-term listed equity (from the highest likely rate to the lowest; the listed long-term part last, its first Rs. 1,25,000 being untaxed) — a long-term loss taking only the long-term parts in that order; shown on every set-off line. Whether the assessee may choose another is OQ-32. The same order applies where another head's loss is set off against capital gains (SETOFF-ACROSS-HEADS). Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-18-capital-gains-basis.md rows 11, 13, 14, 15.
